notes.title: Stage Selection, Achievements and Steam Stats
notes.content:
Hello!
I have noticed that too long track is not good, it will consume the interest of players, so that players give up the experience of the wonderful content behind. 

In fact, most players can't play for six minutes. It's definitely my fault to make players feel anxious or bored. So I made the following updates:

1.Set spawn points at the start of each stages(scenes), remade the map selection menu. Now players could freely choose the scene and play directly without having to drive there.

2.Added steam achievements.

3.Added steam statistics, the player's play data (completion time) will be recorded.

4.Enhanced light and shadow effects.

5.Fixed bugs, optimized the game.

Since the beginning of this year, when I just started to be a developer(not full time), the game has changed a lot. It's thanks to all of your suggestions, good comments and bad comments. All of this promotes progress! Thank you all!

The game developer page of "LBR games" has been set up. Looking forward to your subscription for more new games!
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/38331898

Thank you all again!

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Recently, I received a Negative comment, which I think is very constructive, so I updated this game as follows:            
1. Overturned? Don't worry, it will turn back in a few seconds.            
2. Falling from the sky? Don't worry, the game will pull you back in a few seconds.            
3. Drift dust, there will be dust when drifting or slipping.            
4. Changed the connection between the ground and the sky, an underground missile launch site, so that it is no longer abrupt.
5. Optimize the city map.            
6. Modified the tunnel, better.
7. Fixed some bugs.

Chinese:
最近我收到一个差评，我认为它的意见很有建设性，于是进行了如下的更新：
1.翻车了？不要担心，几秒后会翻回来
2.从天空坠落？不要担心，几秒后游戏会把你拉回来
3.漂移尘土，漂移或打滑时会有尘土。
4.更改了地面与天空的连接，一个地下导弹发射场，让它不再突兀
5.优化了城市地图。
6.修改了隧道，更好。
